title: The Soup from Sausage Peg
summary: The Mouse King announced that whichever mouse maiden could discover the secret of cooking delicious soup from a wooden sausage-peg should become his royal queen....
full_text:
The Mouse King announced that whichever mouse maiden could discover the secret of cooking delicious soup from a wooden sausage-peg should become his royal queen.

Four mouse travelers set out to explore the world. One visited the phantom forest; the second studied the speech of owls; the third brought back magical herbs.

The fourth mouse maiden simply stepped before the king and said: "A soup from a dry wooden peg can only be seasoned by the mind! The secret is this: let him who desires something out of nothing create the substance with his own hands and imagination!"

The Mouse King declared her the wisest in the kingdom and crowned her his queen amid joyous squeaks of mouse approval.
moral: Cooking soup from a wooden skewer requires the seasoning of true observation and intellect.
